div.p: By three independent surveyors, Catherine Mercer, Julien Moreau and Daniel Varga, who shared a simple belief: every successful project begins with a precise understanding of the land.

Each founder brought a different area of expertise, from boundary and topographic surveying to mapping and land development. By joining forces, they created a practice that could bring these disciplines together under one roof.

They chose the name Altitude because elevation is one of the fundamental dimensions of surveying, but also because it reflected their ambition. To them, altitude means taking a broader view, understanding the land from every level, and seeing beyond the measurements themselves.
More than a name, it became the philosophy behind the company: precise data, clear understanding, and a higher perspective on every project.
Today, Altitude combines decades of collective experience with modern surveying and mapping technologies to help clients understand, develop and shape the land with confidence.
